key_points_zh: 支持 OSC 7501 程序状态协议；MCP tool search 的描述截断阈值从 2,048 提升至 16,384 字符。

events.importance_reason_en: Strengthens action control on extension failures and model gateway configuration.

events.title_zh: Hermes 0.21.6：修复登录接管、Git filter 与邮件来源校验
events.title_en: Hermes 0.21.6 fixes login takeover, Git filters and email sender checks
events.summary_zh: 稳定版面向 Docker 与 Hermes Cloud 发布，汇集登录、仓库执行和邮件来源边界修复；桌面应用与 Termux 本轮不更新。
events.summary_en: The stable release ships for Docker and Hermes Cloud with authentication, repository-execution and email-sender boundary fixes; Desktop and Termux do not update in this release.
key_points_zh: 修复 X-Forwarded-For 绕过登录限流、无界审计日志及请求体、非本地重定向导致会话接管。
自动 Git 操作不再执行不受信任仓库配置的 clean / smudge / process filter；修复邮件 From 展示名绕过允许列表。
官方说明该窗口还包含流式转录、插件隔离、本地模型与新模型目录；完整整理说明将随 0.22.0 提供。
key_points_en: Fixes X-Forwarded-For login rate-limit bypass, unbounded audit logs and request bodies, and session takeover through non-loopback redirects.
Automatic Git operations no longer execute clean, smudge or process filters from untrusted repository configuration; fixes email From display names bypassing allowlists.
The release window also includes streaming transcription, plugin isolation, local models and catalog updates; curated notes are planned for 0.22.0.
events.importance_reason_zh: 包含认证与自动执行边界的关键修复，并明确发布渠道。
events.importance_reason_en: Includes critical authentication and automatic-execution fixes with explicit release-channel scope.

events.summary_en: The JetBrains plugin adds MCP OAuth sign-in and recovery, prompt navigation, and a fix for reasoning-context loss during streaming retries.
key_points_zh: 工作流重命名为 commands，内置 CLI 更新至 7.8.8。
key_points_en: Workflows are renamed to commands and the bundled CLI updates to 7.8.8.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展认证能力并改善会话恢复。
events.importance_reason_en: Expands authentication support and improves session recovery.

events.title_zh: Anthropic 承诺三年投入 1.5 亿美元支持 Genesis Mission
events.title_en: Anthropic commits $150M over three years to the Genesis Mission
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布三年投入 1.5 亿美元，向 Genesis Mission 涉及的 15 个以上机构支持 Claude 使用。
events.summary_en: Anthropic announces a $150 million commitment over three years to support Claude access at more than 15 agencies participating in the Genesis Mission.
key_points_zh: 向数百个研究项目提供 Claude、Claude Code 和 API credits。
支持核聚变、量子计算等研究，并提供培训、接入与技术支持。
key_points_en: Provides Claude, Claude Code and API credits to several hundred research projects.
Supports research including fusion energy and quantum computing with training, onboarding and technical assistance.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩大科研机构获得模型与编程工具的渠道。
events.importance_reason_en: Expands research access to models and coding tools.

events.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Cyber Mission 与免费 OSS Scanner
events.title_en: Anthropic launches Cyber Mission and free OSS Scanner
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出关键基础设施防御计划 CIDP 与可自愿加入的开源项目周期安全扫描 OSS Scanner。
events.summary_en: Anthropic launches the Critical Infrastructure Defense Program and OSS Scanner, an opt-in service for periodic open-source security scans.
key_points_zh: CIDP 将前沿 Claude 模型、驻场工程师和威胁研究提供给关键基础设施防御服务商。
OSS Scanner 免费提供模型生成的漏洞报告、概念验证和可用时的修复建议，报告未经人工复核且可能有误。
不适合处理大量发现的项目仍可获得人工验证的协调披露；厂商预期真实阳性率超过 90%，不是本站测试结论。
key_points_en: CIDP provides frontier Claude models, on-site engineers and threat research to critical-infrastructure defense providers.
OSS Scanner supplies free model-generated findings, proofs of concept and suggested fixes when available; reports lack human review and may contain errors.
Projects unable to handle large volumes retain human-verified coordinated disclosures; the expected true-positive rate above 90% is a vendor projection, not our test result.
events.importance_reason_zh: 新增防御工具和前沿模型支持渠道，保留自动报告限制。
events.importance_reason_en: Adds defensive tools and frontier-model support with explicit limits of automated reports.

events.title_zh: Anthropic 预告 11 月 12 日生效的使用政策更新
events.title_en: Anthropic previews usage policy updates effective November 12
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 发布新版使用政策，计划 11 月 12 日生效，明确欺骗性活动、高风险用途和自主物理动作的要求。
events.summary_en: Anthropic publishes updated usage policies scheduled to take effect November 12, clarifying deceptive activity, high-risk uses and autonomous physical actions.
key_points_zh: 合并虚假账号和影响力行动限制；取消个性化投票及竞选定向的全面禁令，欺骗及隐私滥用仍受禁止。
连接可能致伤的硬件时，需由合格操作员观察和停止设备，且断开 Claude 后可保持安全状态。
新增极端、持续且无目的的虐待行为限制，官方说明不针对普通沮丧、质疑、创作或模型测试。
key_points_en: Consolidates fake-account and influence-operation restrictions; removes the blanket personalized-voting and campaign-targeting ban while retaining bans on deception and privacy abuse.
For hardware capable of injury, a qualified operator must observe and stop it, and equipment must maintain a safe state if Claude disconnects.
Adds restrictions on extreme sustained purposeless abuse; Anthropic says ordinary frustration, disagreement, creative work and model testing are excluded.
events.importance_reason_zh: 影响模型接入与 Agent 使用条件，尚未到生效日期。
events.importance_reason_en: Affects model access and agent usage conditions and is not yet effective.

events.title_zh: Google 开源 AQuA：从生产 Agent 轨迹诊断质量问题
events.title_en: Google shares AQuA for diagnosing quality failures in production agents
events.summary_zh: AQuA 在用户 Google Cloud 项目内读取生产轨迹，抽样、评估、聚类、核验和跟踪问题，可按需结合部署时源码快照诊断。
events.summary_en: AQuA reads production trajectories inside a user’s Google Cloud project to sample, review, cluster, verify and track issues, with on-demand diagnosis against deployed source snapshots.
key_points_zh: 每次最多随机抽取 1,000 个会话，最多核验 50 个问题簇，每簇检查最多 3 份完整记录。
处于请求链路之外，不自行改写 Agent 或提交 PR；提供可组合参考实现和本地演示。
轨迹、源码和 BigQuery 数据留在用户项目边界内；采样与模型判断仍可能遗漏或误判。
key_points_en: Randomly samples up to 1,000 sessions per run and verifies up to 50 clusters against up to 3 full transcripts each.
Runs outside the request path, does not edit the agent or open PRs itself, and offers composable reference components and a local demo.
Trajectories, source and BigQuery data remain in the user project; sampling and model judgments can still miss or misclassify problems.
events.importance_reason_zh: 提供生产 Agent 质量诊断工具及可用参考实现。
events.importance_reason_en: Provides production-agent quality diagnostics and a usable reference implementation.

events.title_zh: Google 开源 ML Drift：跨平台端侧 GPU 推理引擎
events.title_en: Google open-sources ML Drift for cross-platform on-device GPU inference
events.summary_zh: Google AI Edge 以 Apache 2.0 开源 ML Drift，既作为 LiteRT GPU 加速核心，也可作为独立库使用。
events.summary_en: Google AI Edge releases ML Drift under Apache 2.0 as both the LiteRT GPU acceleration core and a standalone library.
key_points_zh: 统一 OpenGL ES、OpenCL、Metal 和 WebGPU，增加 5D 张量及自定义算子接口。
传统 TFLite GPU delegate 不再接收新功能；官方建议迁移至兼容旧模型的 ML Drift 加速器。
移动与端侧为主要重点，Windows / Linux 桌面推理仍为预览；性能提升为官方测量结果。
key_points_en: Unifies OpenGL ES, OpenCL, Metal and WebGPU with 5D tensors and custom-operation APIs.
The legacy TFLite GPU delegate stops receiving new features; Google recommends migration to the backward-compatible ML Drift accelerator.
Mobile and edge are the main focus, while Windows and Linux desktop inference remains a preview; performance results are vendor measurements.
events.importance_reason_zh: 新增端侧推理基础设施并明确旧 GPU 后端迁移方向。
events.importance_reason_en: Adds on-device inference infrastructure and a migration path from the legacy GPU backend.

events.title_zh: TRAE 3.4.0：全局 Agent 窗口、远端目录与多仓库任务
events.title_en: TRAE 3.4.0 adds a global Agent workspace, remote directories and multi-repository tasks
events.summary_zh: TRAE 正式推出跨项目调度多个智能体的 Agent 窗口，支持云端与定时任务，并统一管理产物。
events.summary_en: TRAE releases an Agent workspace for coordinating multiple agents across projects, with cloud and scheduled tasks and unified artifact management.
key_points_zh: Agent 窗口与 IDE 可自由切换并同步数据；支持直接以远端开发机目录运行任务。
同一项目可挂载多个路径，文件树和全局搜索跨项目打通；新增桌面常驻对话悬浮球。
key_points_en: Agent and IDE windows can switch and synchronize data; tasks can run directly against remote development directories.
Projects can mount multiple paths with cross-project file trees and global search; adds a persistent desktop chat widget.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展跨项目、远端与后台 Agent 工作流。
events.importance_reason_en: Extends cross-project, remote and background agent workflows.

events.title_zh: Pi 1.1.0：Haiku 5.5、图像分类与程序状态报告
events.title_en: Pi 1.1.0 adds Haiku 5.5, image classification and program status
events.summary_zh: Pi 接入 Claude Haiku 5.5，允许 GPT-6 Luna 经 Decisions API 进行图像分类，并向兼容终端报告运行状态。
events.summary_en: Pi adds Claude Haiku 5.5, enables GPT-6 Luna image classification through the Decisions API, and reports run status to compatible terminals.
key_points_zh: 原生支持 llama.cpp 0.6.0+ 的指定 decision models；这些模型只列为分类器。
修复 MCP OAuth 取消与超时、Bedrock 思考等级和长提示价格计量。
key_points_en: Adds native support for specified decision models on llama.cpp 0.6.0+; these models are listed only as classifiers.
Fixes MCP OAuth cancellation and timeouts, Bedrock reasoning levels and long-prompt cost accounting.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展模型及分类能力，改善授权与费用统计。
events.importance_reason_en: Expands model and classifier support and improves authorization and cost reporting.

events.title_zh: Kilo JetBrains 7.1.9-rc.2 预览 MCP OAuth
events.title_en: Kilo JetBrains 7.1.9-rc.2 previews MCP OAuth
events.summary_zh: 此预览版加入 MCP OAuth 登录与可恢复认证失败处理，并防止附件被拒绝时丢弃正在编写的提示。
events.summary_en: This preview adds MCP OAuth sign-in and recoverable authentication handling, and prevents rejected attachments from discarding a draft prompt.
key_points_zh: 内置 CLI 从 7.8.1 更新至 7.8.8。
key_points_en: The bundled CLI updates from 7.8.1 to 7.8.8.
events.importance_reason_zh: 预览新的 MCP 认证流程。
events.importance_reason_en: Previews a new MCP authentication flow.

events.title_zh: Claude Haiku 5.5 进入 Copilot 付费套餐
events.title_en: Claude Haiku 5.5 arrives in paid Copilot plans
events.summary_zh: GitHub 宣布 Haiku 5.5 正式可用，覆盖 Pro、Pro+、Max、Business 与 Enterprise，并逐步开放到多个客户端。
events.summary_en: GitHub announces general availability of Haiku 5.5 for Pro, Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise, with a gradual rollout across clients.
key_points_zh: 按提供商公开价格消耗用量；组织管理员可通过模型策略管理访问。
CLI 1.0.94-3 已加入模型选择与 --model 补全。
key_points_en: Usage is billed at provider list pricing; organization administrators can manage access through model policies.
CLI 1.0.94-3 adds the model to selection and --model completions.
events.importance_reason_zh: 新增轻量模型选择并明确付费及组织限制。
events.importance_reason_en: Adds a lightweight model option with explicit billing and organizational restrictions.

events.title_zh: Tibo：Codex 与 Work 活跃用户达 4000 万，付费账号加载 banked reset
events.title_en: Tibo reports 40M active Codex and Work users and a paid-account banked reset
events.summary_zh: Tibo 称 Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 活跃用户达到 4000 万，并表示正在为所有付费账号加载 banked reset；原帖未交代统计周期和具体重置额度。
events.summary_en: Tibo reports 40 million active users across Codex and ChatGPT Work and says a banked reset is being loaded for all paid accounts; the post does not specify the measurement period or reset allowance.
key_points_zh: Tibo 称 Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 活跃用户达到 4000 万，并表示正在为所有付费账号加载 banked reset；原帖未交代统计周期和具体重置额度。
key_points_en: Tibo reports 40 million active users across Codex and ChatGPT Work and says a banked reset is being loaded for all paid accounts; the post does not specify the measurement period or reset allowance.
events.importance_reason_zh: 已核实负责人的 AI 一手表述，保留原帖的证据范围。
events.importance_reason_en: A first-party AI statement by a verified leader, preserving the post’s evidence scope.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.94-0：托管策略可关闭 Assisted Permissions
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.94-0 lets managed policy disable Assisted Permissions
events.summary_zh: 托管策略可使会话保持 Manual Approval 模式；组织要求新版 CLI 时显示升级指导，同时允许正常提示继续。
events.summary_en: Managed policy can keep sessions in Manual Approval mode; requests for a newer CLI show upgrade guidance while allowing normal prompts to continue.
key_points_zh: 管理员可关闭 Assisted Permissions。
key_points_en: Administrators can disable Assisted Permissions.
events.importance_reason_zh: 改善企业许可模式的可控性。
events.importance_reason_en: Improves control over enterprise permission modes.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.293：Haiku 5.5 与后台唤醒变更
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.293: Haiku 5.5 and background wakeup changes
events.summary_zh: Claude Code 新增 1M 上下文 Haiku 5.5，同时回退云会话在容器重启后恢复丢失唤醒的 2.1.290 修复。
events.summary_en: Claude Code adds Haiku 5.5 with 1M context and reverts the 2.1.290 fix for cloud sessions recovering wakeups lost after container restarts.
key_points_zh: Haiku 5.5 输入/输出 $0.10/$0.50 每百万 tokens，提示超过 100K 时为 $0.50/$2.50。
新增 agentType 与 Mods isDeferred；当前说明称容器重启丢失唤醒后，会话仍可能保持休眠。
key_points_en: Haiku 5.5 input/output costs $0.10/$0.50 per million tokens, or $0.50/$2.50 for prompts over 100K.
Adds agentType and Mods isDeferred; current notes say sessions may remain asleep after container restarts lose wakeups.
events.importance_reason_zh: 按当前官方订阅说明更新兼容性和后台执行行为。
events.importance_reason_en: Updates compatibility and background execution behavior from current official feed notes.

corrections.reason_zh: 官方 RSS 同一版本原文已变化，当前说明不再包含此前引用的修复条目；按现有证据调整，保留版本 ID 与首次发布日期。
corrections.reason_en: The official RSS text for this version changed and no longer includes the previously cited fixes; revised to current evidence while preserving the version ID and first publication date.

events.title_zh: Codex 0.161.0：默认 GPT-6.1 Sol，扩展 Bedrock 与 MCP 登录
events.title_en: Codex 0.161.0 defaults to GPT-6.1 Sol and expands Bedrock and MCP sign-in
events.summary_zh: Codex 在内置与 Bedrock 目录默认使用 GPT-6.1 Sol，支持会话内 MCP 登录，并将 Daybreak 路由改为显式启用。
events.summary_en: Codex defaults to GPT-6.1 Sol in bundled and Bedrock catalogs, adds in-session MCP sign-in, and requires explicit opt-in for Daybreak routing.
key_points_zh: Bedrock 支持兼容模型的 multi-agent V2 与 Ultra，Mantle 接受 GovCloud 地域。
修复权限继承、恢复历史和过载重试；Daybreak 仍受账号、提供商及模型资格限制。
key_points_en: Bedrock supports multi-agent V2 and Ultra on compatible models, and Mantle accepts GovCloud regions.
Fixes permission inheritance, resumed history and overload retries; Daybreak remains subject to account, provider and model eligibility.
events.importance_reason_zh: 影响默认模型、云提供商能力与权限可靠性。
events.importance_reason_en: Affects the default model, cloud-provider capabilities and permission reliability.

events.title_zh: Demis Hassabis 谈 AI 医疗价值与 CZI 合作
events.title_en: Demis Hassabis discusses AI’s medical value and the CZI partnership
events.summary_zh: Demis Hassabis 表示 AI 最重要的用途是改善医学与健康，并对 CZI 和 Virtual Biology Initiative 合作表示期待；原帖未给出实施细节。
events.summary_en: Demis Hassabis says AI’s most important application is improving medicine and health and expresses excitement about the CZI and Virtual Biology Initiative partnership; the post provides no implementation details.
key_points_zh: Demis Hassabis 表示 AI 最重要的用途是改善医学与健康，并对 CZI 和 Virtual Biology Initiative 合作表示期待；原帖未给出实施细节。
key_points_en: Demis Hassabis says AI’s most important application is improving medicine and health and expresses excitement about the CZI and Virtual Biology Initiative partnership; the post provides no implementation details.
events.importance_reason_zh: 已核实负责人的 AI 一手表述，保留原帖的证据范围。
events.importance_reason_en: A first-party AI statement by a verified leader, preserving the post’s evidence scope.

events.title_zh: Copilot 本地沙箱正式可用，覆盖 CLI、桌面与 VS Code Agent Host
events.title_en: Copilot local sandboxing reaches general availability
events.summary_zh: Copilot 本地沙箱通过 MXC 将统一策略映射到 Windows、macOS 与 Linux 的系统控制，限制工具的文件、网络和凭据访问。
events.summary_en: Copilot local sandboxing uses MXC to map shared policies to Windows, macOS and Linux controls, restricting tool access to files, networks and credentials.
key_points_zh: 组织可强制执行开发者不能削弱的沙箱策略。
功能无额外费用；工具隔离独立于模型选择。
key_points_en: Organizations can enforce sandbox policies that developers cannot weaken.
The feature has no additional charge; tool isolation is independent of model selection.
events.importance_reason_zh: 为本地自主编码提供跨系统的执行边界。
events.importance_reason_en: Provides execution boundaries across operating systems for local agentic coding.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 可发现 Ollama 本地模型，无需重启会话
events.title_en: Copilot CLI discovers Ollama models without a session restart
events.summary_zh: 从 CLI 1.0.94-0 起，/model 可发现已运行 Ollama 的模型，用户确认提供商和端点后添加或切换。
events.summary_en: Starting in CLI 1.0.94-0, /model discovers models from running Ollama instances; users review the provider and endpoint before adding or switching.
key_points_zh: 模型需支持工具调用与流式响应；不会自动安装 Ollama 或下载模型。
本地模型选择不会自动启用离线模式；远程提供商仍可能接收代码和提示。
key_points_en: Models must support tool calling and streaming; the flow does not install Ollama or download models.
Selecting a local model does not enable offline mode automatically; remote providers may still receive code and prompts.
events.importance_reason_zh: 减少本地模型接入步骤并明确网络行为。
events.importance_reason_en: Reduces local-model setup steps and clarifies network behavior.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.93：组织网络边界与长上下文配置
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.93 adds managed network boundaries and context fixes
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 加入企业 permissions.limitTo 网络域限制，支持回合间应用 MCP 配置，并正确读取启动时长上下文选项。
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI adds enterprise permissions.limitTo domain boundaries, applies MCP configuration between turns, and honors long-context options at startup.
key_points_zh: 用户设置仅从 ~/.copilot/settings.json 读取，config.json 的用户设置键将被忽略。
连接缺少 GitHub scope 时可就地更新授权；修复插件技能重载。
key_points_en: User settings are read only from ~/.copilot/settings.json; user-setting keys in config.json are ignored.
Connections missing GitHub scopes can update authorization in place; fixes plugin-skill reloads.
events.importance_reason_zh: 涉及组织策略及现有用户配置迁移。
events.importance_reason_en: Affects organizational policy and migration of existing user settings.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 预告 College Planner 与青少年学习工具
events.title_en: OpenAI previews College Planner and teen learning tools
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 预告面向美国四年制大学申请的 College Planner，整合申请要求、截止日期、任务与助学金步骤。
events.summary_en: OpenAI previews College Planner for U.S. four-year college applications, combining requirements, deadlines, tasks and financial-aid steps.
key_points_zh: 青少年体验自动应用于被识别为未满 18 岁的账号，默认开启保护。
公告同时提及闪卡、测验和青少年 AI 理事会；College Planner 尚待推出。
key_points_en: The teen experience applies automatically to accounts identified as under 18, with protections enabled by default.
The announcement also mentions flashcards, quizzes and a teen AI council; College Planner is still upcoming.
events.importance_reason_zh: 预告申请规划与学习功能，并明确适用人群。
events.importance_reason_en: Previews application-planning and study features with explicit target users.

events.title_zh: Kilo 7.8.8：隔离 MCP OAuth 凭据并支持置顶工作树
events.title_en: Kilo 7.8.8 isolates MCP OAuth credentials and pins worktrees
events.summary_zh: Kilo 将 OAuth 凭据绑定到签发的授权服务器，避免 MCP 服务更换服务器后获得旧凭据；VS Code Agent Manager 可置顶工作树。
events.summary_en: Kilo binds OAuth credentials to the issuing authorization server to prevent reuse after an MCP server changes issuers; VS Code Agent Manager can pin worktrees.
key_points_zh: 实验性 Integrated Browser 开启时聊天链接默认在应用内打开，可改回系统浏览器。
key_points_en: With experimental Integrated Browser enabled, chat links open in-app by default; users can select the system browser instead.
events.importance_reason_zh: 关键认证修复及多会话管理改进。
events.importance_reason_en: Includes a critical authentication fix and multi-session management improvements.

events.title_zh: Cline 4.1.23：修复自定义 Claude 端点并保留截断 MCP 输出
events.title_en: Cline 4.1.23 fixes custom Claude endpoints and preserves truncated MCP output
events.summary_zh: Cline 修复自定义 Anthropic 端点 400 错误、Kimi K3 不支持的思考等级和截断 MCP 输出不可继续读取的问题。
events.summary_en: Cline fixes HTTP 400 errors on custom Anthropic endpoints, unsupported reasoning levels for Kimi K3 and inaccessible truncated MCP output.
key_points_zh: 无法识别响应完成原因时继续一次，而非直接视为完成。
免费模型列表加入 Solar Mini 4，移除 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 与 space-bunny-alpha。
key_points_en: When a response has no recognized finish reason, Cline continues once instead of treating it as complete.
The free-model list adds Solar Mini 4 and removes DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and space-bunny-alpha.
events.importance_reason_zh: 修复模型接入与结果完整性问题。
events.importance_reason_en: Fixes model connectivity and result-completeness issues.

events.title_zh: Cline Desktop 0.0.44：恢复无 Key 本地模型与断线会话
events.title_en: Cline Desktop 0.0.44 restores keyless local models and reconnects sessions
events.summary_zh: 桌面版修复 LM Studio、Ollama、vLLM 等无需 API Key 的提供商每回合失败，并在 Hub 断线后自动重连最多一分钟。
events.summary_en: The desktop release fixes per-turn failures for providers such as LM Studio, Ollama and vLLM that need no API key, and reconnects Hub sessions for up to a minute.
key_points_zh: 聊天可交互显示 Mermaid；修复 Windows npx/uvx MCP 启动超时及自定义 Claude 端点。

其他 IDE 修复预计在 2026 年 11 月前完成；CLI 用户不需为此升级。
key_points_en: Billing is unaffected; missing history cannot be backfilled, and accurate metrics resume after updating.
Other IDE fixes are expected to finish rolling out by November 2026; CLI users need no update for this issue.

events.title_zh: Google 发布 EmbeddingGemma 2：740M 参数的端侧多模态嵌入模型
events.title_en: Google releases EmbeddingGemma 2, a 740M on-device multimodal embedder

输出 768 维，可截断至 512、256 或 128 维；Google 宣称可降低端侧检索存储成本。
key_points_en: The text module has 270M parameters and the complete model 740M; context is 8K tokens.
Outputs 768 dimensions with truncation to 512, 256 or 128; Google says this lowers storage costs for on-device retrieval.

events.importance_reason_en: Adds an open foundation model for on-device cross-modal retrieval.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.292：MCP 协议与插件执行接口更新

claude plugin test 的 hook expect 或被引擎拒绝的 stub 现在会使测试失败。

Local stdio MCP defaults to 2026-07-28, including Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry; MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy opts out.
Hook expect failures or engine-rejected stubs now fail claude plugin test.

events.summary_en: Kilo announced that Desktop is available to download, bringing coding and data analysis into one app. The company says it supports more than 500 models, with multi-folder workspaces, direct notebook editing, conda environment management, and a local model server. Users can also connect their own providers and API keys.

提供 Code、Plan、Ask、Debug 四种 Agent；批准计划后，Code 可通过子 Agent 并行执行子任务。

key_points_en: Workspaces group multiple local folders so agents can read context across projects.
Four agents are included: Code, Plan, Ask, and Debug. After a plan is approved, Code can run subtasks in parallel through subagents.
Supports direct notebook editing, conda environment management, and local or bring-your-own-key models.
Team administrators can restrict models, providers, geographies, agent permissions, and installable skills.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展 Kilo 的桌面开发和数据分析入口，并提供多模型及本地推理的统一工作流。

events.importance_reason_en: Adds mobile interaction with local tasks.

events.title_zh: Anthropic 扩展 Cyber Verification Program，分三级开放能力
events.title_en: Anthropic expands the Cyber Verification Program into three access tiers
events.summary_zh: Anthropic 将 CVP 与 Project Glasswing 整合为分级验证计划，为符合资格的安全人员开放更强网络安全能力与较少拦截。
events.summary_en: Anthropic combines CVP and Project Glasswing into a tiered verification program offering qualifying security professionals stronger cyber capabilities and reduced blocking.
key_points_zh: Defense Access 面向防御任务；Red Team Access 增加获授权的渗透测试，当前仅限组织。
Specialized Access 限少量深度核验组织；支持 Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5 与 Mythos 5.1 等模型。
key_points_en: Defense Access covers defensive tasks; Red Team Access adds authorized penetration testing and currently accepts organizations only.
Specialized Access is limited to a small set of deeply verified organizations; supported models include Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Mythos 5.1.
events.importance_reason_zh: 改变安全专业用户获取模型能力的资格与范围。
events.importance_reason_en: Changes eligibility and scope for professional access to cyber model capabilities.

events.title_zh: Google AI Edge 推出端侧媒体搜索与 Foresight Mac 实验应用
events.title_en: Google AI Edge introduces local media search and the Foresight Mac experiment
events.summary_zh: Google AI Edge Gallery 新增媒体语义搜索与视频时刻定位；Foresight Mac 使用本地模型协助会议记录及私有文件检索。
events.summary_en: Google AI Edge Gallery adds semantic media search and video-moment retrieval; Foresight for Mac uses local models to assist with meeting notes and private-file retrieval.
key_points_zh: 基于 EmbeddingGemma 2；MediaPipe Tasks 提供多模态嵌入、检索和决策接口。
Android ML Kit 服务与 NPU 加速将在未来数周提供，尚未作为当前发布能力。
key_points_en: Powered by EmbeddingGemma 2; MediaPipe Tasks provides multimodal embedding, retrieval and decision interfaces.
Android ML Kit service and NPU acceleration are planned for the coming weeks and are not presented as available now.
events.importance_reason_zh: 提供可体验的端侧多模态检索与会议工作流。
events.importance_reason_en: Provides usable on-device multimodal retrieval and meeting workflows.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.290：强化权限检查，修复后台任务与长会话恢复
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.290 strengthens permission checks and background-task recovery
events.summary_zh: Claude Code 2.1.290 扩展 Mods 与插件 hook 信息，并修复多项权限规则、读取边界和组织插件检查问题。后台定时任务、长会话及代理网关兼容性也有修复；WebFetch 对超过 100,000 字符的正文会提示未读取部分并支持 offset 续读。
events.summary_en: Claude Code 2.1.290 expands information available to Mods and plugin hooks and fixes multiple permission-rule, read-boundary and organization-plugin checks. It also repairs background scheduling, long-session recovery and proxy/gateway compatibility; WebFetch reports unread text beyond 100,000 characters and supports continuing with an offset.
key_points_zh: 修复符号链接、图片读取和 PreToolUse 改写输入后部分权限检查未生效的问题。
修复定时任务在压缩或后台切换后未恢复，以及恢复、重启或 fork 时额外执行的问题；压缩恢复修复适用于本版起创建的压缩。
tool.check 增加 agentId，Mods hook 可读取组织要求的审批 ceiling；turn.step 提供 serverToolUses。
key_points_en: Fixes missed permission checks involving symlinks, image reads and inputs rewritten by PreToolUse.

Fixes scheduled tasks failing to recover after compaction or background handoff and extra runs on resume, respawn or fork; the compaction recovery fix covers compactions made from this version onward.
tool.check adds agentId, Mods hooks expose the organization’s approval ceiling, and turn.step exposes serverToolUses.
events.importance_reason_zh: 涉及权限边界、后台任务可靠性和插件兼容性的重要更新。
events.importance_reason_en: Affects permission boundaries, background-task reliability and plugin compatibility.

events.title_zh: Pi 1.0.4：工具通配符与单次禁用 MCP，修复图像与 OAuth 支持
events.title_en: Pi 1.0.4 adds tool patterns and per-run MCP disabling, fixes images and OAuth
events.summary_zh: Pi 1.0.4 让 --tools 与 --exclude-tools 支持 * 通配符，新增 --no-mcp 单次关闭 MCP，并修复 --tools 意外移除 MCP 工具的问题。Codemode 可通过 tools.read() 获取图像块；采用 OpenID Connect 客户端注册的 MCP 服务也有 OAuth 兼容修复。
events.summary_en: Pi 1.0.4 adds * patterns to --tools and --exclude-tools and --no-mcp to disable MCP for one run, while fixing --tools unexpectedly removing MCP tools. Codemode can obtain image blocks with tools.read(), and MCP OAuth compatibility is fixed for servers using OpenID Connect client registration.
key_points_zh: --tools 默认保留 MCP 工具，除非某个筛选项以 mcp__ 开头。
读取图片会返回可由 image() 展示的图像块。
MCP OAuth 注册改为原生客户端；修复连接尚未完成时退出导致 transport 残留的问题。
key_points_en: --tools retains MCP tools unless an entry starts with mcp__.
Reading an image returns an image block that image() can display.
MCP OAuth registers as a native client; shutdown fixes prevent transports remaining open while connection is still pending.
events.importance_reason_zh: 改善工具权限选择、图像处理和 MCP 身份认证兼容性。
events.importance_reason_en: Improves tool selection, image handling and MCP authentication compatibility.

events.title_zh: Tibo 谈 ChatGPT 协作 Space：正在每天快速改进
events.title_en: Tibo says collaborative Space in ChatGPT is improving rapidly each day
events.summary_zh: Tibo 表示 Sergio 正在改进 ChatGPT 中的协作 Space，并称其每天都在大幅进步。原帖没有列出具体功能、上线时间或套餐范围。
events.summary_en: Tibo says Sergio is improving collaborative Space inside ChatGPT and describes rapid progress each day. The post does not identify specific features, release timing or plan availability.
key_points_zh: 这是负责人对产品进展的直接表述。
原帖未提供可单独确认的新功能清单。
key_points_en: This is a product lead’s direct statement about product progress.
The post does not provide a list of independently confirmable new features.
events.importance_reason_zh: 保留已核实负责人对关注产品的一手进展说明。
events.importance_reason_en: Preserves first-hand product-progress commentary from a verified lead.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.92：整合配置与环境选择，改善沙箱及长会话
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.92 brings configuration and environment selection, improves sandboxing
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.92 的稳定版说明整合配置子命令、对话前本地／云环境选择及一系列沙箱、MCP 和长会话修复。后台 agent 可在运行中接收消息调整当前任务，Canvas action 也可向模型返回图像。
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.92’s stable release notes combine configuration subcommands, local/cloud environment selection before a conversation, and sandbox, MCP and long-session fixes. Messages can steer a running background agent’s active turn, and Canvas actions can return images to the model.
key_points_zh: 新增 copilot config 的列出、读取、设置与删除操作，以及对话前 Ctrl+E 环境选择器。
沙箱 shell 默认不传递环境中的 GITHUB_TOKEN，除非显式配置；长上下文恢复保留最新请求。
修复 Entra MCP 静默续期、OAuth 重新认证后工具继续使用和远程会话恢复认证。
key_points_en: Adds copilot config operations to list, read, set and remove settings, plus a pre-conversation Ctrl+E environment picker.
Sandboxed shells withhold ambient GITHUB_TOKEN unless explicitly configured; context recovery retains the latest requests.
Fixes silent renewal for Entra MCP, continued tool use after OAuth reauthentication and authentication on remote-session resume.
events.importance_reason_zh: 稳定版确认重要权限、工作流与会话可靠性变化。
events.importance_reason_en: The stable release confirms significant permission, workflow and session-reliability changes.

events.title_zh: Codex 0.160.1：保留远程 Windows MCP 执行环境变量
events.title_en: Codex 0.160.1 preserves remote Windows MCP environment variables
events.summary_zh: Codex 0.160.1 修复 Unix 主机启动远程 stdio MCP 服务时的环境变量传递：即使显式配置远程环境变量，也会保留 Windows 执行器需要的 SYSTEMROOT、TEMP 和 TMP。
events.summary_en: Codex 0.160.1 fixes environment forwarding when Unix hosts launch remote stdio MCP servers: SYSTEMROOT, TEMP and TMP needed by the Windows executor are preserved even when remote environment variables are explicitly configured.
key_points_zh: 修复针对 Unix 主机与 Windows 远程执行器组合。
该变更回移植到 0.160 系列。
key_points_en: The fix targets Unix hosts paired with Windows remote executors.
The change is backported to the 0.160 series.
events.importance_reason_zh: 修复跨系统远程 MCP 启动所需的环境兼容性。
events.importance_reason_en: Fixes environment compatibility required for cross-platform remote MCP startup.

events.title_zh: Tibo：ChatGPT 订阅中的 Astra 与 GPT-6.1 Sol 默认速度提高约 50%
events.title_en: Tibo says Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol default speed increased about 50% on subscriptions
events.summary_zh: Tibo 表示，GPT-6 Astra 与 GPT-6.1 Sol 通过订阅使用时的默认速度已优化约 50%，覆盖 OpenAI 产品及使用 Sign in with ChatGPT 的合作产品，如 OpenCode、Pi、Amp 和 Devin。用户无需更改设置；他在原帖中预计两小时内可感受到变化。
events.summary_en: Tibo says default speed for GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol on subscriptions has been optimized by about 50%, across OpenAI products and partners using Sign in with ChatGPT, including OpenCode, Pi, Amp and Devin. Users need no setting changes; he expected the improvement to be felt within two hours of the post.
key_points_zh: 该表述针对订阅及 Sign in with ChatGPT 接入，没有说明 API Key 调用也获得相同提速。
约 50% 是 Tibo 的表述，原帖没有提供基准测试方法。
key_points_en: The statement covers subscription and Sign in with ChatGPT access, without confirming the same speedup for API-key calls.
About 50% is Tibo’s claim; the post provides no benchmark methodology.
events.importance_reason_zh: 负责人对实际模型服务速度和合作产品范围的一手说明。
events.importance_reason_en: First-hand information from a product lead about serving speed and partner coverage.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 扩展文本水印：API 可选开启，欧盟 ChatGPT 与 Codex 将逐步应用
events.title_en: OpenAI expands text watermarking: API opt-in now, EU ChatGPT and Codex to follow
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示将内容溯源扩展到文本。全球 API 客户可为部分模型开启文本水印；欧盟 ChatGPT 与 Codex 的适用文本将在未来几周逐步应用水印，以响应欧盟监管要求。官方同时强调当前文本水印技术存在明显局限。
events.summary_en: OpenAI says it is expanding content provenance to text. API customers worldwide can opt into text watermarking for select models today; eligible text in ChatGPT and Codex in the EU will start receiving watermarks over the coming weeks in response to EU regulatory requirements. OpenAI also acknowledges significant limitations of current text-watermarking technology.
key_points_zh: API 为部分模型提供可选水印；不表示所有模型或所有文本均支持。
欧盟 ChatGPT 与 Codex 的应用仍是未来几周的计划，不能视为已全部上线。
依据为官方 RSS 摘要与 X 公告，没有把水印描述为可靠识别所有 AI 文本的方法。
key_points_en: API watermarking is opt-in for select models, rather than covering every model or text.
EU ChatGPT and Codex deployment is planned for the coming weeks and is not described as fully live.
Evidence consists of the official RSS summary and X announcement; watermarking is not presented as reliable detection of all AI text.
events.importance_reason_zh: 涉及 API 选项及 ChatGPT、Codex 输出溯源的重要可用性变化。
events.importance_reason_en: A significant availability change for API options and output provenance in ChatGPT and Codex.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.92-5：完善 Entra 账号选择、退出与 MCP 续期
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.92-5 improves Entra account selection, sign-out and MCP renewal
events.summary_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.92-5 改进 Microsoft Entra 登录后的账号选择，使 /logout 能退出相应 OAuth 会话，并修复仅持有 access token 的 Entra MCP 凭据静默续期。
events.summary_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.92-5 improves account selection after Microsoft Entra sign-in, lets /logout sign out those OAuth sessions, and fixes silent renewal of access-token-only credentials for Entra-protected MCP servers.
key_points_zh: 登录后可选择使用的 Microsoft Entra 账号。
/logout 覆盖对应 OAuth 会话；access-token-only MCP 凭据可静默续期。
key_points_en: Choose the Microsoft Entra account after sign-in.
/logout covers the corresponding OAuth sessions, and access-token-only MCP credentials can renew silently.
events.importance_reason_zh: 影响企业身份认证和 MCP 连接连续性。
events.importance_reason_en: Affects enterprise authentication and continuity of MCP connections.

events.title_zh: OpenAI 公告 ChatGPT 新视觉广告格式及测量工具扩展
events.title_en: OpenAI announces a new visual ad format and expanded measurement for ChatGPT
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 官方 RSS 摘要宣布 ChatGPT 的新视觉广告格式，并提到测量工具、归因合作和广告主品牌适配能力的扩展。当前取得的是摘要，未提供具体投放地域、价格或适用套餐。
events.summary_en: OpenAI’s official RSS summary announces a new visual ad format in ChatGPT and expanded measurement tools, attribution partnerships and brand suitability for advertisers. The available summary does not specify rollout regions, pricing or eligible plans.
key_points_zh: 新格式面向 ChatGPT 广告。
测量、归因合作与品牌适配是官方摘要明确列出的扩展方向。
key_points_en: The new format is for ads in ChatGPT.
Measurement, attribution partnerships and brand suitability are the expansion areas explicitly listed in the official summary.
events.importance_reason_zh: 涉及 ChatGPT 平台广告格式与广告工具能力的变化。
events.importance_reason_en: A change to ChatGPT’s advertising format and advertising-tool capabilities.

events.title_zh: Pi 1.0.3：接入 Azure Foundry Chat Completions，Azure 配置需迁移
events.title_en: Pi 1.0.3 adds Azure Foundry Chat Completions and requires Azure config migration
events.summary_zh: Pi 1.0.3 的 Azure provider 新增 Foundry Chat Completions 部署支持，首个模型为 azure/deepseek-v4-pro。provider 从 azure-openai-responses 更名为 azure，现有登录与模型配置需迁移；此外修复 OAuth 刷新期间取消请求导致订阅登录失效的问题。
events.summary_en: Pi 1.0.3 adds Foundry Chat Completions deployments to its Azure provider, starting with azure/deepseek-v4-pro. The provider is renamed from azure-openai-responses to azure, requiring migration of authentication and model settings. It also fixes subscription logins failing when a request is cancelled during OAuth refresh.
key_points_zh: 更新 auth.json、models.json 和 settings.json 中的 provider 名称，或重新执行 /login；AZURE_OPENAI_* 环境变量不变。
使用旧 provider 的会话恢复时会退回其他模型，且不会复用原 prompt cache。
Codemode image() 同时把图像写入临时文件并返回路径，生成文件仅当前用户可读。
key_points_en: Rename the provider in auth.json, models.json and settings.json, or run /login again; AZURE_OPENAI_* environment variables are unchanged.
Resumed sessions using the old provider fall back to another model without reusing their previous prompt cache.
Codemode image() also writes images to temporary files and returns their paths; generated output files are readable only by the user.
events.importance_reason_zh: 包含需要用户迁移配置的破坏性变更和新的模型部署接入。
events.importance_reason_en: Includes a breaking configuration migration and a new deployment integration.

events.title_zh: 马斯克：把超级智能传播到星际是一种成功条件
events.summary_zh: 马斯克在 X 表示，把超级智能传播到星际，是他所称“生物引导程序”的一种理想成功条件。原帖表达个人观点，未宣布具体产品或实施时间。
key_points_zh: 将超级智能向星际传播描述为成功条件；原帖没有具体产品安排。
events.importance_reason_zh: 已核实负责人关于超级智能发展方向的一手观点。
events.title_en: Elon Musk describes spreading superintelligence to the stars as a success condition
events.summary_en: Musk said on X that spreading superintelligence to the stars is a desirable success condition for what he calls a biological bootloader. The post states a personal view without announcing a product or timeline.
key_points_en: Describes spreading superintelligence to the stars as a success condition, without a specific product plan.
events.importance_reason_en: A verified leader’s first-hand view on the direction of superintelligence.

events.title_zh: Kiro IDE 1.2.37 收紧本地状态访问，改善中断后的工作保留
events.title_en: Kiro IDE 1.2.37 tightens local-state access and preserves completed work during interruptions
events.summary_zh: Kiro 官方更新摘要称，IDE 1.2.37 收紧 macOS 和 Linux 上的本地状态访问，在中断期间保留已完成的工作，并将模型搜索与推理努力程度控制整合在一起。
events.summary_en: Kiro’s official changelog summary says IDE 1.2.37 tightens access to local state on macOS and Linux, preserves completed work during interruptions, and combines model search with effort controls.
key_points_zh: macOS 和 Linux 的本地状态访问控制得到加强。
中断期间保留已完成的工作。
模型搜索与努力程度控制整合；订阅摘要未说明更细的实现条件。
key_points_en: Strengthens local-state access controls on macOS and Linux.
Preserves completed work during interruptions.
Combines model search with effort controls; the feed summary does not describe detailed implementation conditions.
events.importance_reason_zh: 涉及本地状态访问和中断恢复，对开发工作可靠性有直接影响。
events.importance_reason_en: Local-state access and interruption recovery directly affect the reliability of development work.

corrections.reason_zh: 按官方更新页的日期标签保留日期精度，去除 RSS 中用于表示日期的午夜时刻。
corrections.reason_en: Preserves the date-only precision of the official release label, removing the RSS midnight timestamp used to represent that date.

events.title_zh: Devin 工作区新增 Terminal 标签，并开放 Review 努力程度控制
events.title_en: Devin adds a workspace Terminal tab and Review effort controls
events.summary_zh: Devin 10 月 5 日更新在会话工作区新增 Terminal 标签，用于在 Devin 的机器上运行命令；Files 可在会话休眠时打开，打开 Files 或 Terminal 会唤醒 Devin。更新还允许触发动作设置 Review 努力程度，并新增读取单个代码扫描结果的 API/MCP 能力。
events.summary_en: Devin’s October 5 update adds a Terminal tab to the session workspace for running commands on Devin’s machine. Files can be opened while a session is asleep; opening Files or Terminal wakes Devin. Trigger actions can also set Review effort levels, and API/MCP users can fetch individual code scans.
key_points_zh: 工作区 Terminal 可运行命令，Files 和 Terminal 均可唤醒休眠会话。
Review 触发动作可指定努力程度，企业管理员可设置企业 Review 的默认值。
有仓库访问权但无 Review 执行权限的用户，可查看 PR、差异和已有发现，AI Review 动作对其隐藏。
GET /v3/organizations/{org_id}/code-scans/{scan_id} 可读取单个扫描及附件链接；MCP 对应提供 get_scan 动作。
key_points_en: The workspace Terminal runs commands; both Files and Terminal can wake sleeping sessions.
Review trigger actions can specify effort levels, and enterprise administrators can set an enterprise default.
Users with repository access but no permission to run Review can inspect PRs, diffs, and existing findings; AI Review actions are hidden.
GET /v3/organizations/{org_id}/code-scans/{scan_id} retrieves an individual scan and attachment URLs; MCP provides a corresponding get_scan action.
events.importance_reason_zh: 扩展会话内操作入口、审阅权限控制及代码扫描集成能力。
events.importance_reason_en: Expands in-session controls, review permissions, and code-scan integration.

events.title_zh: Kiro CLI 2.28.0：Classic 会话可切换至 3.0
events.title_en: Kiro CLI 2.28.0 switches Classic sessions to 3.0
events.summary_zh: 官方更新订阅表示，Classic 交互会话可在终端内切换到 3.0，V3 Hooks 支持按工具类别匹配，并改善长 V3 会话可靠性。
events.summary_en: The official changelog feed says interactive Classic sessions can switch to 3.0 in the terminal, V3 Hooks can match tool categories, and long V3 sessions become more reliable.
key_points_zh: 当前订阅为简短说明，未提供完整迁移步骤与兼容性清单。
key_points_en: The feed provides a brief description, without complete migration steps or a compatibility list.
events.importance_reason_zh: 提供现有 Classic 用户迁入 3.0 的明确路径。
events.importance_reason_en: Provides an explicit migration path from Classic to 3.0.

events.title_zh: Demis Hassabis 谈 AI 加速科学与医学的社会影响
events.summary_zh: Demis Hassabis 在 X 表示，他为团队利用 AI 加速科学和医学、造福社会的工作影响感到自豪。取得的原帖文字没有列出具体项目或新的研究结果。
key_points_zh: 本人评价 AI 用于科学和医学的社会影响，未在原帖文字中说明具体项目。
events.importance_reason_zh: 已核实负责人对 AI 科学与医学应用的一手观点。
events.title_en: Demis Hassabis reflects on AI’s impact in science and medicine
events.summary_en: Hassabis said on X that he was proud of his team’s impact using AI to accelerate science and medicine for society. The retrieved post text does not identify specific projects or new research results.
key_points_en: Offers his assessment of AI’s societal impact in science and medicine without naming a project in the retrieved text.
events.importance_reason_en: A verified leader’s first-hand view on AI applications in science and medicine.

events.title_zh: Tibo 预告未来 28 天：每天改进 Codex / Work 或进行完整重置
events.summary_zh: Tibo 表示，未来 28 天每天将推出一项对多数 Codex / Work 用户有明显帮助的改进，或进行一次完整重置。原帖没有列出改进清单、重置对象或额度规则。
key_points_zh: 计划持续 28 天，每天提供明确改进或完整重置。
未说明重置范围和具体执行条件；该表述属于负责人预告。

events.title_en: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-alpha.1: experimental Claude Code Mods compatibility and automation changes
events.summary_en: DeepSeek Harness releases the 0.2.1-alpha.1 preview with an experimental Claude Code Mods compatibility layer. It currently tests API capability mappings and does not provide complete, practical compatibility. Automation becomes built into the Web interface, with breaking changes to plugin and extension interfaces. The release also fixes messages stuck in the queue after repeated task stops and Windows desktop startup failures caused by reserved ports.
key_points_en: The experimental Claude Code Mods layer mainly tests whether its API capabilities roughly form a subset of Harness plugin capabilities; it does not establish full compatibility.

Automation becomes built into the Web interface. Reminder tools are available in standard, creative and PTC modes, but not in minimal mode or subagents. Old experimental bundle selections are cleared; existing tasks are retained.
Web adds --public-url to display, open and provide the external URL to the model, including reverse-proxy URLs with path prefixes.

Removes the runtime invariant plugin and ./invariant exports from packages. Extensions and custom profiles using these diagnostics must be updated. Subpath plugins no longer read a separate package.json. Input statistics extensions split into activity and usage; plugins overriding the old stats row need updated registration IDs.

Fixes new messages remaining queued after a target task is stopped, resumed and stopped again. Desktop uses a system-assigned port by default to avoid Windows reserved-port startup failures. Fixes missing bundle dependencies and mappings left after disabling bundles; replacing an installed bundle version still requires a restart.
events.importance_reason_en: Affects automation mode availability, cross-ecosystem plugin experiments and existing extension compatibility. Users of old plugin diagnostics or statistics extensions need to review migration requirements.

events.summary_zh: Tibo 发帖称“Reset all propagated. Enjoy.”，表示重置已经全部传递生效。该短帖没有交代重置对象或额度规则。
key_points_zh: Tibo 表示重置已全部传递生效。
原帖未说明涉及的产品、账户范围或额度规则。
events.importance_reason_zh: 保留负责人简短的重置状态通报，便于跟踪实际使用相关动态。
events.title_en: Tibo says the reset has fully propagated
events.summary_en: Tibo posts “Reset all propagated. Enjoy.”, saying that the reset has fully propagated. The short post does not identify what was reset or the quota rules.
key_points_en: Tibo says the reset has fully propagated.
The post does not specify the product, account scope or quota rules.
events.importance_reason_en: Preserves the lead’s brief reset-status update for following developments relevant to usage.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.288：改善长会话恢复与 MCP 授权
events.summary_zh: 正式版本修复超时、自动压缩及会话恢复中的上下文丢失问题，并支持 MCP 工具调用时申请更多 OAuth 权限。
key_points_zh: 非交互会话和子 Agent 可从超时前的部分响应继续；修复零 token 用量导致未自动压缩的问题。
恢复会话时保留刚从压缩中恢复的文件与上下文，并修复转录加载截断。
MCP 请求更多作用域时可重新认证；BASHPID 算术赋值的权限检查会先提示。
events.importance_reason_zh: 直接影响长任务连续性与工具权限验证。
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.288: better long-session recovery and MCP authorization
events.summary_en: This stable release fixes context loss during timeouts, automatic compaction and session recovery, and allows MCP tools to request additional OAuth permissions when called.
key_points_en: Non-interactive sessions and subagents can continue from partial responses before a timeout; fixes automatic compaction being skipped when token usage is zero.
Session recovery preserves files and context just restored from compaction, and fixes truncated transcript loading.
MCP can reauthenticate when additional scopes are requested; permission checks prompt before BASHPID arithmetic assignments.
events.importance_reason_en: Directly affects continuity in long tasks and validation of tool permissions.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.92-1 预览：改善 MCP 重连与上下文续接
events.summary_zh: 本次预览更新处理远程 MCP HTTP 连接过期、后台任务引导和上下文滚动后的请求保留。
key_points_zh: 远程 MCP 连接过期后可重新连接。
向运行中的后台任务发送消息会引导当前工作。
上下文滚动时保留最近请求；修复错误报告子 Agent 已配置的问题。
events.importance_reason_zh: 影响长任务的工具连接与请求连续性；稳定性结论仍需后续使用验证。
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.92-1 preview: MCP reconnection and context continuity
events.summary_en: This preview addresses expired remote MCP HTTP connections, steering background tasks and retaining requests after context rollover.
key_points_en: Reconnects remote MCP connections after they expire.
Messages sent to a running background task steer its current work.
Retains recent requests after context rollover; fixes incorrect reports that subagents are configured.
events.importance_reason_en: Affects tool connections and request continuity in long tasks; stability still needs validation through use.

events.title_zh: Tibo：可让 dot 创建宠物并设为头像
events.summary_zh: Tibo 表示，用户可以让 dot“创建宠物并设为头像”，素材可以来自想法或图像等。原帖未交代各订阅档位的可用性和限制。
key_points_zh: 本人介绍通过 dot 从想法或图像创建宠物并设为头像的用法。
events.importance_reason_zh: 已核实负责人对 dots 宠物与头像功能的一手说明。
events.title_en: Tibo says a dot can create a pet and set it as an avatar
events.summary_en: Tibo said users can ask a dot to create a pet and set it as an avatar, based on an idea, an image or other inspiration. The post does not specify availability or restrictions by subscription tier.
key_points_en: Describes asking a dot to create a pet from an idea or image and use it as an avatar.
events.importance_reason_en: A verified leader’s first-hand explanation of dots’ pet and avatar workflow.

events.title_zh: Gemini CLI 10 月 2 日夜间版：原子存储与损坏恢复
events.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 的夜间预览版改善对话记录写入、状态备份恢复和运行中断处理。
key_points_zh: ChatRecordingService 改用追加式增量补丁与有界历史窗口。
状态持久化采用原子方式，并可从备份恢复损坏状态。
Ctrl+C 紧急中止能在活动操作期间到达处理器；修复输入和滚动相关问题。
events.importance_reason_zh: 涉及记录损坏恢复和紧急停止可靠性，但尚非稳定发布。
events.title_en: Gemini CLI October 2 nightly: atomic storage and corruption recovery
events.summary_en: This Gemini CLI nightly preview improves conversation recording, state backup recovery and interruption handling.
key_points_en: ChatRecordingService switches to append-only incremental patches and a bounded history window.
State persistence uses atomic writes and can recover corrupted state from backups.
Ctrl+C emergency abort reaches the handler during active operations; fixes input and scrolling issues.
events.importance_reason_en: Addresses record corruption recovery and emergency-stop reliability, but is not yet a stable release.

events.title_zh: Codex 0.160.0：项目外会话、权限恢复与 Windows 修复
events.summary_zh: 本次正式更新改善会话恢复、Windows 沙箱及子 Agent 环境准备，并增加按需启用的 Guardian 审查上下文。
key_points_zh: 策略允许时，可在项目外用工作区默认配置启动会话；恢复会话时还原已保存权限。
修复 Windows PowerShell 回退、长路径权限修复和后台控制台窗口问题。
重连后继续发送未发出的排队消息，同时避免重复发送；子 Agent 能保留仍在启动的环境。
events.importance_reason_zh: 影响会话连续性与 Windows 开发环境的稳定性。
events.title_en: Codex 0.160.0: sessions outside projects, permission recovery and Windows fixes
events.summary_en: This stable update improves session recovery, Windows sandboxing and subagent environment preparation, and adds opt-in Guardian review context.
key_points_en: When policy allows, sessions can start outside projects using workspace defaults; resuming a session restores saved permissions.
Fixes Windows PowerShell fallback, long-path permission repair and background console window issues.
Continues sending unsent queued messages after reconnection without duplicate delivery; subagents retain environments that are still starting up.
events.importance_reason_en: Affects session continuity and the stability of Windows development environments.

events.title_zh: Pi 1.0.0：默认全屏界面，强化 MCP OAuth 校验
events.summary_zh: Pi 的正式 1.0 版本启用默认全屏终端界面，并加入脚本内图像生成、Radius 登录及更严格的 MCP OAuth 验证。
key_points_zh: 全屏 TUI 成为默认，仍可选择常规界面。
新增 models.generateImages；支持 Radius 登录和 MCP。
MCP OAuth 检查 RFC 9207 的发行方标识，并按服务端步骤处理凭据与作用域。
events.importance_reason_zh: 同时改变默认交互方式并增强第三方工具授权验证。
events.title_en: Pi 1.0.0: a full-screen interface by default and stricter MCP OAuth checks
events.summary_en: Pi’s stable 1.0 release enables a full-screen terminal interface by default and adds image generation in scripts, Radius login and stricter MCP OAuth verification.
key_points_en: The full-screen TUI becomes the default; the regular interface remains available.
Adds models.generateImages and support for Radius login and MCP.
MCP OAuth checks the issuer identifier defined in RFC 9207 and handles credentials and scopes according to server steps.
events.importance_reason_en: Changes the default interaction experience and strengthens authorization checks for third-party tools.

events.title_zh: Claude Code 2.1.287：推出 Claude Mods，修复权限保护缺口
events.summary_zh: 新版本允许插件修改更深层行为，新增可选的辅助观察 mod，并修复危险删除命令及 MCP 工具权限上限的保护问题。
key_points_zh: 新增 Claude Mods；内置 You should know 由旁侧 Agent 提醒遗漏，限开启遥测的第一方会话。
支持 MCP 2025-11-25 协议的 URL 提示；部分服务器可能需要 bareElicitationCapability 兼容配置。
修复重定向路径使危险 rm 命令丢失始终询问保护，以及名为 __proto__ 的 MCP 工具丢失组织权限上限的问题。
events.importance_reason_zh: 提供新的插件能力，同时修复实际权限控制缺口。
events.title_en: Claude Code 2.1.287: Claude Mods and permission protection fixes
events.summary_en: Plugins can now modify deeper behavior, with an optional observer mod, alongside fixes for protections around dangerous delete commands and MCP tool permission ceilings.
key_points_en: Introduces Claude Mods. The built-in You should know mod uses a side agent to point out omissions, limited to first-party sessions with telemetry enabled.
Supports URL elicitation in MCP protocol 2025-11-25; some servers may need bareElicitationCapability compatibility configuration.
Fixes redirected paths bypassing always-ask protection for dangerous rm commands, and MCP tools named __proto__ losing organization permission ceilings.
events.importance_reason_en: Adds plugin capabilities and fixes concrete permission-control gaps.

events.title_zh: 马斯克：Star Mind 超级智能航天器将拥有超过 250 kW 太阳能功率
events.summary_zh: 马斯克称，每艘 SpaceX Star Mind 超级智能航天器将拥有超过 250 kW 的太阳能功率，约比国际空间站高 20%。这是他对未来配置的表述，原帖没有提供部署时间。
key_points_zh: 马斯克给出的目标是每艘 Star Mind 航天器超过 250 kW 太阳能功率。
他称这一功率约比国际空间站高 20%；帖子未说明部署时间。
events.importance_reason_zh: 保留已核实负责人对 AI 基础设施的一手预告，规模比较保留本人归属。
events.title_en: Musk: Star Mind superintelligence spacecraft will have over 250 kW of solar power
events.summary_en: Musk says each SpaceX Star Mind superintelligence spacecraft will have over 250 kW of solar power, about 20% more than the International Space Station. This describes a future configuration; the post gives no deployment date.
key_points_en: Musk describes a target of over 250 kW of solar power for each Star Mind spacecraft.
He says this is about 20% more than the International Space Station; the post gives no deployment date.
events.importance_reason_en: Preserves a verified leader’s firsthand AI infrastructure preview, with the scale comparison attributed to him.

events.title_zh: Copilot CLI 1.0.91：完善 Windows 沙箱与证书管理
events.summary_zh: 正式版本为沙箱 CA 增加检查、创建、信任、轮换与移除能力，同时调整 Windows 环境兼容性及执行证据审查。
key_points_zh: 新增 copilot sandbox ca 命令，可检查、创建、信任、轮换和移除代理 CA 信任，并支持 Windows 无人值守设置；/sandbox ca install 改为 create 和 trust。
可静态分析的完整只读命令管道进入执行证据审查；不完整的分析仍要求明确批准。
改善 node/npm 的 EACCES 网络绕行处理及沙箱行为。
events.importance_reason_zh: 直接影响 Windows 使用、联网工具运行及权限判断。
events.title_en: Copilot CLI 1.0.91: Windows sandbox and certificate management improvements
events.summary_en: This stable release adds sandbox CA inspection, creation, trust, rotation and removal, while improving Windows compatibility and execution evidence review.
key_points_en: Adds copilot sandbox ca commands to check, create, trust, rotate and remove proxy CA trust, including unattended Windows setup; /sandbox ca install becomes create and trust.
Complete read-only command pipelines that can be statically analyzed enter execution evidence review; incomplete analysis still requires explicit approval.
Improves network bypass handling for node/npm EACCES errors and sandbox behavior.
events.importance_reason_en: Directly affects Windows usage, networked tools and permission decisions.

corrections.reason_zh: 对照当前官方 RSS 原文，更正旧摘要中误写的 /sandboxca install，并补齐 /sandbox ca install 改为 create 和 trust 的命令迁移说明。
corrections.reason_en: Checked against the current official RSS text, corrected the misspelled /sandboxca install in the previous summary and clarified that /sandbox ca install becomes create and trust.

events.title_zh: Gemini CLI 10 月 1 日夜间版：修复 @code 卡顿与文件写入竞争
events.summary_zh: 这一夜间预览版本集中修复可能导致任务卡住或文件工具相互干扰的问题。
key_points_zh: 防止 @code 场景出现 CPU 挂起。
文件工具操作串行化，并采用原子写入。
events.importance_reason_zh: 修复会影响实际任务能否继续完成的问题，属于预览阶段。
events.title_en: Gemini CLI October 1 nightly: fixes for @code stalls and competing file writes
events.summary_en: This nightly preview focuses on fixes for problems that can stall tasks or cause file tools to interfere with one another.
key_points_en: Prevents CPU hangs in @code scenarios.
Serializes file-tool operations and uses atomic writes.
events.importance_reason_en: Fixes issues that can prevent tasks from finishing; the release remains in preview.
